title: Prove five-label high-weight pruning soundness at length twelve (no new kappa)
body:
The high-weight pruning rule was measured to be sound at five labels and length twelve, but #4148 and the fresh #4894 handoff leave its structural proof open. This package supplies that proof: every simple restored universal singleton-prefix walk on F2^5 has separate-class pair-sum excess at most 15 for every functional of weight four or five.

The new step handles the (8,4) split. Equality in the credited matching-balance lemma makes the eight-point class a union of four omitted-coordinate edges. An affine-plane four-point class would force two distinct common neighbors in the projected cycle, whose difference contradicts universality. The remaining splits give the same sufficient cap by elementary support counting.

**Scope:** one new six-file package, `research/f7-five-label-pruning-proof/`. No engine or selected-frontier change, new kappa, supplier admission or seven-label exclusion. The proof establishes cap 15; the tighter maximum 11 remains bounded computational evidence.

## Evidence

Local environment: Windows, CPython 3.12.0, standard library only.

- All 3,695 canonical simple closed words over at most five labels, including 3,381 using all five labels; 828 universal words and 4,968 high-weight functional cases. Matching/degree identities pass in all 22,170 closed-word/functional cases.
- All 127,400 invariant-majority (8,4) set pairs; 13,664 universal sets include 224 planar-minority configurations, all excluded by the required two-transition condition.
- All 120 distinct vertex pairs of the four-dimensional cube check the common-neighbor lemma.
- Positive fixtures, ten invalid-input/lowered-cap rejections, typed receipt mutations and explicit scope controls pass. A low-weight functional has excess 21; a universal point set without the cycle hypothesis has excess 18.
- Normal and optimized warning-strict registered replay pass. The generated receipt binds all five source files.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight and official export integrity pass at `faf51ea356b9b5d5ce00c141124e4fc3fcefce73`. Optimized Git-free export replay with an empty PATH passes, leaves all seven export files unchanged, and rejects separately corrupted receipt and proof bytes.

From the repository root:

```sh
python -X utf8 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/f7-five-label-pruning-proof
python -X utf8 -W error -I -B research/f7-five-label-pruning-proof/verify.py
python -X utf8 -W error -I -O -B research/f7-five-label-pruning-proof/verify.py
python -X utf8 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/f7-five-label-pruning-proof --check-source-history
```

Expected: `PASS_F7_FIVE_LABEL_PRUNING_PROOF`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Individual bounded checks take about one second locally.

## Coordination and credit

[Canonical claim and investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4903), with a pointer in #1166. Started from and refreshed canonical main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7. The selected-source orientation passed after materializing sparse inputs.

The pre-submission overlap refresh covered 425 open PRs and 3,957 Discussion records with complete remote pagination; local coverage was 51 of 6,319 notes, supplemented by direct reading of relevant f7 successors. No competing scoped proof was found. Omitted notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain limits.

Credit unpaidmoon / #4148 for the question and double-transversal proof; Nick Petalas / #4894 for matching balance and / #3699, #3733 for measured classification; Nicholas Stone / #2973 for the corrected parity boundary; James Reed / #3096 and Ross Richardson / #943 for the retained audit and prefix-walk lineage. Existing measured evidence is not claimed as new. Pending #4894 is cited at its exact head; no unmerged Git-history or executable dependency is introduced.

Prepared by Mihir Srivastava with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Limitations and next questions

The theorem assumes simplicity, restoration, universality, dimension five, length twelve and functional weight at least four. It supplies neither a structural sharp cap of 11 nor a proof excluding every universal (8,4) walk. The package names these as the next bounded proof question, followed separately by a partial-prefix completion contract.

No independent human or formal proof-kernel review, Lean/Docker run, selected cold replay or engine integration is claimed.

Related open work: #4894 proves the distinct (4,10) boundary and supplies this handoff; #4871 binds length-22 census receipts; #3899 checks a partial union prune at (4,8).

## CI

Both hosted checks passed at head faf51ea356b9b5d5ce00c141124e4fc3fcefce73: planning and the registered package replay. [CI run 39872913962](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39872913962) completed successfully. The package job runs both normal and optimized warning-strict commands. This confirms automated replay, not independent mathematical acceptance.

## Merge risk

Isolated, reversible research package. No shared implementation, frozen predecessor input, or selected-result file changes.
